Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Deck Name : Childer of the Vulture
Author : Norman S. Brown, Jr
Description :
This is a weenie Gangrel Antitribu Embrace deck where you use Clan
Impersonate and Muricia's Special to tool up the Gangrel Antitribu
with Superior Spiritus to Vulture Buffet or Embrace every turn.

Crypt [12 vampires] Capacity min: 2 max: 7 average: 4.67
------------------------------------------------------------

4x Muricia 7 ANI PRE SPI Ahrimane:4
1x Janey Pickman 6 ANI PRO for !Gangrel:4
1x Charlie Tyne 4 obf pro ser !Gangrel:4
1x Jeffrey Mullins 4 OBF cel !Gangrel:4
1x Rashid Stockton 4 cel obf vic !Gangrel:5
1x Bill Butler 3 pot pro !Gangrel:4
1x Lula Burch 3 for pro !Gangrel:4
1x Denette Stensen 2 obf !Gangrel:4
1x Leo Washington 2 cel pro !Gangrel:4

Library [90 cards]
------------------------------------------------------------

Action [34]
7x Clan Impersonation
15x Embrace, The
12x Vulture's Buffet

Action Modifier [24]
8x Cloak the Gathering
8x Squirrel Balance
8x Veil the Legions

Combat [1]
1x Claws of the Dead

Master [19]
1x Campground Hunting Ground
3x Effective Management
1x Elder Library
1x Hungry Coyote, The
4x Obfuscate
1x Storage Annex
8x Tribute to the Master

Retainer [12]
12x D'habi Revenant

Crafted with : Anarch Revolt Deck Builder. [Thu Dec 20 15:30:57 2007]

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: Janne Hägglund
Messages.Body:
XZealot <xze...@cox.net> writes:

> Because the sterile trait is directly linked to being an Ahrimane.

Where does it say so?

The online rulebook (chapter 11, "Special terms") says:
"Sterile: Sterile vampires cannot take actions to put other vampires in
play."

And "Rules glossary" from the same source:
"Sterile: A vampire that cannot take an action to create a vampire."

That's *all*. Nowhere does it say that it's linked to being an Ahrimane.
In fact, the only mention of Ahrimanes is a list of Sabbat clans and
bloodlines.

HG

Real world example:

I buy a blue chair.
I saw off the back of the chair.
Now I have a table.
Is the table still blue?
Answer: yes, because the "blueness" and "chairness" had nothing to do
with each other.

Back to card text:

".. becomes a sterile Ahrimane".
Are the sterile trait and the membership of clan Ahrimane connected by
game rules (like the title of prince and membership of the Camarilla
sect)?
Answer: no.
So, if one changes, the other is unaffected.
